youtube.titulo: One step 1 inch taller = you fall? (Team Norm or Flo)
youtube.descripcion:
Flo says one inch doesn't matter. Norm says your feet disagree. Research shows people don't notice a slightly taller stair riser, and their toe doesn't lift high enough to clear it. That's why US building codes allow no more than 3/8 inch difference between risers in a flight. Measure every riser and make them all the same.

Team Norm or Team Flo? Fight in the comments!

Follow for more backyard builds that won't fail!

For general education only. Codes vary by location: check your local code and a licensed professional.
